description: This file defines functions and types related to Slack channel configuration and notification handling, including resolving channel labels, configurations, and determining whether to emit reaction notifications.

methods.name: firstDefined
methods.description: Returns the first defined value from the provided list of values.

methods.name: shouldEmitSlackReactionNotification
methods.description: Determines whether a Slack reaction notification should be emitted based on provided parameters and mode.

methods.name: resolveSlackChannelLabel
methods.description: Generates a Slack channel label string based on channel ID or name.

methods.name: resolveSlackChannelConfig
methods.description: Resolves the configuration for a Slack channel based on provided parameters and configuration entries.
